description.value: Cafe Algan is a specialty coffee shop and bakery on the corner of W 58th and Paulson Street in south Vancouver, known for house-made Japanese-style shio pan, croissants, and Basque cheesecakes alongside specialty coffee and first-harvest matcha. The cafe occupies a neighbourhood corner spot and also offers catering services. Online pre-ordering is available, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 11m; stands (16 spaces) at 39m; stands (2 spaces) at 68m; stands (2 spaces) at 73m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m; stands (14 spaces) at 84m; stands (12 spaces) at 91m. Total: 52 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the cafe is an active business at 688 W 58th Avenue, Vancouver, directly matching the OSM address and email. The menu page explicitly marks several Basque cheesecake items as 'Gluten free,' and the site prominently features a 'Pre-Order Online' system confirming takeout availability. No bike-specific amenities, Wi-Fi, washroom mention, or water refill information appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Th-Tu 10:00-17:00, implying Wednesday closed) conflicts with the website (Tuesdays closed, weekdays 10am-4pm, weekends 10am-5pm). Website is preferred.
No phone number listed in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible specialty cafe with a live website, online ordering, and a full menu — a legitimate and useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists in south Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page explicitly marks Classic Basque Cheesecake and Tiramisu Basque Cheesecake (both whole and individual slices) as 'Gluten free'
